notes:
What's new in 0.1.129:
- Sharing with another household: this PC is now ready for a coming phone app update that accepts a share with just its share code and one press. This PC does the accept itself, so the phone never handles the licence, and only the owner or an admin of this home can accept a share this way. The current phone app (1.75) does not use it yet.
- Browser player: screen readers now find one main area on the player page, holding the title bar and the video, so they can jump straight to it; the page looks and works the same as before.
- Windows only. The phone app (1.75, build 147) and Beebo Auto (1.22) are separate releases.
- Automated checks: the merged changes were tested on the 375 Windows desktop test files they touch, and all 375 passed; the new share-code accept has its own 10 tests, which pass. The share-code change had two clear code reviews (it touches sharing between households) and the player change one. The signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. The full Windows desktop test suite was not run on this release, and no person has installed this version or tried its in-app update yet.
- Release source commit 13d5e8790.
- Built: Nov 17, 2026, 2:06 PM Eastern.
- Published: Nov 17, 2026, 2:13 PM Eastern.
